summary: A late Election Day canvass runs in drizzle, then snow, with almost nobody left who has not already voted.
realLife: A volunteer in a Minnesota suburb spent three hours on three streets and found one voter who had not yet voted.
sources: Mark Bernstein, The Human Cost of Canvassing, December 2018: https://www.MarkBernstein.org/Dec18/TheHumanCostofCanvassing.html
